explication: InterTune is an Android music player combining YouTube Music and local audio. The main user journey is choosing music, building or changing a queue, and listening through the playback service; recommendations, downloads, lyrics, casting, and recognition are significant companion capabilities. The graph uses README claims and the supplied source excerpts/index for its links; several feature implementations are unsampled, so their connections are documented or marked unverified rather than inferred from filenames.
